note_replacement.text: 4QDeutj (4Q37) reads ‘sons of God’; the Masoretic Text and Samaritan Pentateuch read ‘sons of Israel.’ The main Greek Septuagint reading is ‘angels of God.’ The earliest exact Hebrew wording remains debated; ‘sons of El’ is an editorial reconstruction rather than an extant Hebrew reading in the consulted sample edition.

replacement.rationale: Provisional rendering of the selected published 4Q37 phrase, not an approved source change. ‘Divine beings’ is an interpretive rendering; ‘sons of Israel’ represents the retained Masoretic/Samaritan source alternative, and ‘sons of El’ the separately identified conjecture. These are not interchangeable glosses of one source form. No new lexicon consultation or full-verse manuscript attestation is claimed.
